text: Nearly VND 2-trillionTan Cang Industrial Park project in Thanh Hoa to break ground soon
The Tan Cang Thanh Hoa Industrial Park project in central Thanh Hoa province is scheduled to break ground on December 19.
The project is designed to integrate industrial production with logistics, warehousing, and business services, with an estimated workforce of about 29,000 people.
The Tan Cang Thanh Hoa Industrial Park is the initial phase in the planning of the Luu Binh Industrial Park, which spans approximately 470 hectares.
The initial phase covers an area of about 160 hectares, with a total investment of nearly VND2 trillion (nearly $77.5 million).
The industrial park is divided into four functional zones, aimed at serving various stages in production and goods circulation.
Zone A is designated for high-tech industries, prioritizing electronics, components, and smart devices; it is located near the 110 kV power station and main traffic axis.
Zone B focuses on mechanical engineering and supporting industries, including precision mechanics, automotive, and motorcycle parts, with large plots and roads capable of bearing heavy loads.
Zone C is oriented towards logistics and warehousing, including bonded warehouses, CFS warehouses, container yards, and distribution centers.
Zone D serves as the operations and service center, with offices, customs, banks, accommodation for experts, and amenities for workers.
A highlight in the development orientation of the industrial park is the integration of production with logistics services.

The system is expected to include bonded warehouses, CFS warehouses, empty container yards, and cargo handling services; it also aims to provide on-site customs services, electronic declarations, and inspections within the industrial park.
Transportation activities are oriented to connect multiple modes, including road, waterway, and railway, along with the port network of Tan Cang Saigon and international shipping lines.
If these services are implemented synchronously, businesses can perform multiple transportation and warehousing stages within the same system, reducing transit time for goods.
The industrial park is located in the southern part of Thanh Hoa Province, between the provincial center and Nghi Son Economic Zone.
Along with regional roads, including the route from Thang Phu Bridge to National Highway 1A, this location is expected to facilitate the transportation of goods and commuting for workers.

With a development orientation towards high-tech industries, mechanical engineering, supporting industries, and logistics, the Tan Cang Thanh Hoa Industrial Park is expected to attract manufacturing enterprises, component suppliers, and transport service providers.
The project is anticipated to create jobs for approximately 29,000 workers.
